name: James W. Foley
role: Bismarck agent of the N. P. Refrigerator Car Co.
bio: James W. Foley was the Bismarck agent and salesman of the Northern Pacific Refrigerator Car Company who visited Medora on company business in 1885. In November 1886 the paper said he would probably take charge of the company's Medora interests.

mentions: Mr. Foley, salesman for the N. P. Ref. Car Co. at Bismarck, was in town on Tuesday. He says business of all kinds is very dull in Bismarck.
James W. Foley, Bismarck agent of the N. P. R. Car Co., has been in Medora for several days.
James Foley, of Bismarck, arrived in Medora last evening.
